pages.quiz:
GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Water Cycle and Action of Rivers is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Water Cycle and Action of Rivers never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Water Cycle and Action of Rivers.
   C. Treat Water Cycle and Action of Rivers as rumours only.
   D. Explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   B. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   C. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Measure rainfall only

5. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.
   B. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Soils is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Soils with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Soils.
   C. Treat Soils as rumours only.
   D. Say Soils never happens in Kenya.

7. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

8. Which statement about Weather is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Weather with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Weather.
   C. Say Weather never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Weather as rumours only.

9. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

10. Which statement about Weathering is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Weathering as rumours only.
   B. Explain Weathering with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Weathering.
   D. Say Weathering never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Mass Wasting is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Mass Wasting.
   B. Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Mass Wasting as rumours only.
   D. Say Mass Wasting never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Elementary Surveying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. D — Plan income and spending wisely

3. D — Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. C — Explain symbols used on a map

5. C — Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. A — Explain Soils with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. A — Nairobi

8. A — Explain Weather with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. D — Obeying laws and caring for public property

10. B — Explain Weathering with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. B — Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. B — Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Map Reading and Interpretation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Elementary Surveying; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Statistical Methods; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Geographic Information Systems; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
